title: Ann Arbor Scavenger Hunt Interactive Walking Activity
includes: One self-guided scavenger hunt interactive walking tour for a team of up to 15 people
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Registration Instructions will be found on the Email/Voucher after completing purchase
Must have a US cellular data service plan
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore Ann Arbor in a unique and interactive way with the Scavenger Hunt Walking Tour. This adventure combines a scavenger hunt, an amazing race, and a self-guided tour, all through the lens of the city's rich history. Uncover fascinating facts about the University of Michigan and its notable alumni while visiting iconic landmarks like the Michigan Theater. With 158 parks to explore and intriguing challenges to solve, the app-led experience allows for flexible timing, letting you enjoy the vibrant art scene at your own pace. Snap selfies and finish with a stunning view of the carillon, creating unforgettable memories.
